text: この　さきを　いくと　みずのさんぽみちに　でる！

structure.jp: この　さきを　いくと
structure.en: if you go on ahead from here

structure.jp: みずのさんぽみちに　でる！
structure.en: you come out at Water Path!

patterns.name: 〜と (whenever)
patterns.explanation: と after a plain verb means 'when you do this, that always follows'. この　さきを　いくと = 'if you go on ahead'.

patterns.name: 〜を (path)
patterns.explanation: With verbs of moving, を shows the stretch you travel along. さきを　いく = 'go along the way ahead'.

patterns.name: 〜にでる
patterns.span: みずのさんぽみちに　でる
patterns.explanation: に でる means to come out at a place, not to leave it. みずのさんぽみちに　でる = 'you come out at Water Path'.
